SELECT cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bin, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/SUM(anglers),3) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('HD_AM','HD_PM','TWILIGHT')
GROUP BY cls, doy_bin
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY cls, doy_bin
